reviewOutcome: A Kashan-local map procedure is evidenced, but no qualifying public cadastral parcel-polygon service or safe retained geometry sample was verified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Persian first-party discovery was performed and recorded in the city record. The Kashan engineering organization’s official page documents an electronic building-plan map system built with Kashan Municipality and authenticated access. Anonymous GET probes to the linked service, Kashan municipal site, and national cadastral candidates timed out; no login or bypass was attempted. No schema, CRS, bounded ID+geometry response, or parcel polygon was obtained.
cityOrLocalCustodian: The Kashan branch of Iran’s Construction Engineering Organization and Kashan Municipality are evidenced as local custodians of an electronic building-plan map workflow. The national cadastral candidates are attributed to Iran’s registration organization at the service/domain level, but no live anonymous parcel layer was verified.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel/object ID when independently verified
schemaAndCrs: No usable public response was returned, so schema and CRS remain unverified. The local source description mentions plan, area and property-location records but does not publish a parcel-layer schema or CRS.
uncertainty: Timeouts and authenticated-service indications are access limitations, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence. The exact WUP point was not moved to seek a hit. Local building-plan mapping should not be conflated with an open cadastral parcel source.
integrationDisposition: Research packet only; not source integration or admission. No registry/catalog/runtime files were changed.
